name: Space Child
storyline: You awaken on a strange alien world, disoriented and alone. With only your AI companion to guide you, you must navigate the planet’s secrets, recover lost memories, and uncover the truth behind your journey through space.
summary: Space Child is an adventure-exploration game where you play as a space traveler stranded on an alien planet with no memories. Guided only by your personal AI assistant, you must uncover your past and find a way back home. The game blends narrative-driven exploration with puzzle-solving in a mysterious sci-fi setting.
